policies.name: scoped audit read
policies.using:
(is_global_administrator() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM care_recipients r
  WHERE (((r.id)::text = (audit_events.metadata ->> 'care_recipient_id'::text)) AND can_manage_recipient(r.id)))))

policies.name: scoped membership read
policies.using: (can_manage_recipient(care_recipient_id) OR ((user_id = auth.uid()) AND (current_profile_role() IS NOT NULL)))

policies.name: authorized template or own product read
policies.using: ((current_profile_role() IS NOT NULL) AND ((owner_care_recipient_id IS NULL) OR can_access_recipient(owner_care_recipient_id)))

policies.name: users insert requisition items
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM requisitions r
  WHERE ((r.id = requisition_items.requisition_id) AND (r.created_by = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: users read scoped requisition items
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM requisitions r
  WHERE ((r.id = requisition_items.requisition_id) AND can_access_recipient(r.care_recipient_id))))

policies.name: users read scoped requisition observations
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM requisitions r
  WHERE ((r.id = requisition_observations.requisition_id) AND can_access_recipient(r.care_recipient_id))))

policies.name: users read scoped requisition status history
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM requisitions r
  WHERE ((r.id = requisition_status_history.requisition_id) AND can_access_recipient(r.care_recipient_id))))

policies.name: authorized users create own requisitions
policies.check:
((created_by = auth.uid()) AND (current_profile_role() = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::profile_role, 'supervisor'::profile_role, 'professional'::profile_role])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM care_recipients c
  WHERE ((c.id = requisitions.care_recipient_id) AND c.is_active))))

policies.name: users read scoped inventory items
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM stock_inventories i
  WHERE ((i.id = stock_inventory_items.inventory_id) AND can_access_recipient(i.care_recipient_id))))

policies.name: authorized users read scoped stock movements

constraints.name: care_recipient_memberships_care_recipient_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (care_recipient_id) REFERENCES care_recipients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: care_recipient_memberships_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: care_recipient_products_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 2) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 160)))

constraints.name: care_recipients_display_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM display_name)) >= 2) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM display_name)) <= 160)))

constraints.name: historical_requisition_imports_batch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES requisition_import_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: profiles_full_name_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM full_name)) >= 2) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM full_name)) <= 160)))

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: requisition_items_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (custom_name IS NULL)) OR ((product_id IS NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM custom_name)) > 0))))

constraints.name: requisition_items_requisition_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (requisition_id) REFERENCES requisitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: requisition_notifications_recipient_label_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM recipient_label)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM recipient_label)) <= 160)))

constraints.name: requisition_notifications_requisition_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (requisition_id) REFERENCES requisitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: requisition_observations_body_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM body)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM body)) <= 1000)))

constraints.name: requisition_observations_requisition_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (requisition_id) REFERENCES requisitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: requisition_status_history_reason_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((reason IS NULL) OR ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) <= 1000))))

constraints.name: requisition_status_history_requisition_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (requisition_id) REFERENCES requisitions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: stock_inventory_items_inventory_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (inventory_id) REFERENCES stock_inventories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: stock_inventory_items_justification_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((justification IS NULL) OR ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM justification)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM justification)) <= 1000))))

constraints.name: stock_movement_locations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_location IS NULL) OR (source_location = ANY (ARRAY['FAMILY'::text, 'CARE_TEAM'::text]))) AND ((destination_location IS NULL) OR (destination_location = ANY (ARRAY['FAMILY'::text, 'CARE_TEAM'::text])))))

constraints.name: stock_movements_justification_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM justification)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM justification)) <= 1000)))
